page.overview:
Who is Augusta Flanders?

Augusta Flanders (née Wynd) (1860-1917) was the wife of Sir Nederick Flanders and the mother of Neduchadnezzar Flanders and Commander Flanders. she is the great-grandmother of Ned Flanders
